{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders with revenue 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[~sales['revenue'].isin([999999.99])]

# Drop refunded orders (only completed orders count)
sales_final = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute raw conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = sales_final.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute average revenue by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = sales_final.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean()

# Compute conversion rate within each segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = sales_final.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack()

# Print only the numbers that are actually in the output
print('Raw conversion rate by channel:')
print(conversion_by_channel)

print('\nAverage revenue by channel:')
print(avg_revenue_by_channel)

print('\nConversion rate by channel and segment:')
print(conversion_by_channel_segment)"}
